def MellinConvergent (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) : Prop :=
  IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f t) (Ioi 0)

theorem fourier_deriv
    {f : ℝ → E} (hf : Integrable f) (h'f : Differentiable ℝ f) (hf' : Integrable (deriv f)) :
    𝓕 (deriv f) = fun (x : ℝ) ↦ (2 * π * I * x) • (𝓕 f x) :=
noncomputable def C3 : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, Λ n * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ))
noncomputable def Cg : ℝ := ∫ u, ‖gC u‖
theorem Cg_eq : Cg = 92 * Real.exp (-(1 / 2)) - 12 * Real.exp (3 / 2) :=
theorem Cg_eq_integral : Cg = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..2, t * (2 - t) ^ 3 * Real.exp (t - 1 / 2) :=
theorem Cg_le : Cg ≤ 2.03 :=
noncomputable def E0b (N : ℕ) : ℝ := 112 * (Real.log (BP N 0 / 0.355) / Real.log (10 / 3))

noncomputable def E2b (N : ℕ) (T0 δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  EB T0 * (2 * Z3 N T0 / (1 - rhoB) + 2 * c3 T0 / (1 - rhoB) ^ 2) +
    EA T0 δ * (2 * Z3 N T0 / (1 - rhoA δ) + 2 * c3 T0 / (1 - rhoA δ) ^ 2)

noncomputable def E2g (B : ℝ → ℝ) (κ T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  EB' * (2 * Z3g B T0 / (1 - ρB) + 2 * c3g κ T0 / (1 - ρB) ^ 2) +
    EA' * (2 * Z3g B T0 / (1 - ρA) + 2 * c3g κ T0 / (1 - ρA) ^ 2)

noncomputable def EA (T0 δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if δ = 0 then 0 else 0.588 * (T0 / (π * |δ|)) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-0.1065 * (T0 / (π * |δ|)) ^ 2)
noncomputable def EB (T0 : ℝ) : ℝ := 0.892 * T0 * Real.exp (-0.1598 * T0)

noncomputable def Fline {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (φ : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -(deriv χ.LFunction s / χ.LFunction s) * mellin φ s * (x : ℂ) ^ s

structure GoodSmoothing (φ : ℝ → ℂ) (K c : ℝ) : Prop where
  continuousAt : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → ContinuousAt φ y
  conv : MellinConvergent φ ((3 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  diff : ∀ s : ℂ, -1 < s.re → DifferentiableAt ℂ (mellin φ) s
  c_pos : 0 < c
  strip : ∀ s : ℂ, -1 / 2 ≤ s.re → s.re ≤ 3 / 2 → ‖mellin φ s‖ ≤ K * Real.exp (-(c * |s.im|))

theorem GoodSmoothing.integrable_line {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {σ : ℝ}
    (h1 : -1 / 2 ≤ σ) (h2 : σ ≤ 3 / 2) : Integrable fun t : ℝ => mellin φ ((σ : ℂ) + t * I) :=
noncomputable def Gr (s : ℂ) (δ θ : ℝ) : ℂ := ∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), Jr s δ θ r

theorem Gr_eq (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : |θ| < π / 4) (hs : -2 < s.re) :
    Gr s δ θ = Gr s δ 0 :=

theorem Gr_zero_eq (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) :
    Gr s δ 0 = ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) *
      (((t ^ 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * cexp (2 * π * I * δ * t)) :=

noncomputable def Jr (s : ℂ) (δ θ r : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (r : ℂ) ^ (s + 1) * cexp (θ * I * (s + 2)) *
    cexp (-(r : ℂ) ^ 2 * cexp (2 * θ * I) / 2 + 2 * π * I * δ * r * cexp (θ * I))

theorem LB_le_linear {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (T : ℝ) :
    Real.log (BT N T / 0.355) ≤ DN N + 37 + 2.6 * |T| :=

theorem LFunction_ne_zero_strip {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {z : ℂ} (h1 : -1 < z.re) (h2 : z.re < 0) : χ.LFunction z ≠ 0 :=
theorem PhiG_phi2_le (u : ℝ) : ‖PhiG phi2 u‖ ≤ 9.93 * Real.exp (-(1 * |u|)) :=

noncomputable def Ssum {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (δ x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, (Λ n : ℂ) * χ n * fδ δ (n / x)

noncomputable def SsumG {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (φ : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, (Λ n : ℂ) * χ n * φ (n / x)
noncomputable def Z3 (N : ℕ) (T0 : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.log (BP N T0 / 0.355) / Real.log (10 / 3)

noncomputable def ZL (N : ℕ) (T0 : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (BP N (T0 + 3.48) / 0.355) / Real.log (10 / 2.3)
theorem cA_le : Cg * (2 * aH) ≤ 129.24 :=
theorem cA_sq_le : (Cg * (2 * aH)) ^ 2 ≤ 16703 :=

theorem count_line_window {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {T T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 0 ≤ T0) (S : Finset ℂ) (hS : S ⊆ zerosRect χ T)
    (hre : ∀ u ∈ S, u.re = 1 / 2) (him : ∀ u ∈ S, |u.im| ≤ T0) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => (⌊u.im / 3.48⌋ + Jl T0).toNat = k), (multRect χ T u : ℝ) ≤ ZL N T0 :=

theorem count_tail_window {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {T T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 0 < T0) (S : Finset ℂ) (hS : S ⊆ zerosRect χ T)
    (hre : ∀ u ∈ S, 0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1) (him : ∀ u ∈ S, T0 < |u.im|) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => ⌊(|u.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ = k), (multRect χ T u : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Z3 N T0 + 2 * c3 T0 * (k + 1) :=

theorem count_tail_windowG (hp : PolyDatum f B κ) {T T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 0 < T0) (S : Finset ℂ)
    (hS : S ⊆ zerosRectD f T) (hre : ∀ u ∈ S, 0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1) (him : ∀ u ∈ S, T0 < |u.im|)
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => ⌊(|u.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ = k), (multRectD f T u : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Z3g B T0 + 2 * c3g κ T0 * (k + 1) :=

theorem differentiableAt_G (δ : ℝ) {s : ℂ} (hs : -2 < s.re) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s => Gr s δ 0) s :=
theorem etaPlus_sq_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : etaPlus t ^ 2 ≤ 9.9225 * (t ^ 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2)) :=

theorem exp_shift_le {c y u : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hu : |u| ≤ 200) :
    Real.exp (-(c * |y + u|)) ≤ Real.exp (200 * c) * Real.exp (-(c * |y|)) :=

theorem explicit_formula {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) (δ : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k : ℕ, T k ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) + 1) ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => ∑ u ∈ zerosRect χ (T k), (multRect χ (T k) u : ℂ) * (Gr u δ 0 * (x : ℂ) ^ u))
        atTop (𝓝 (-Ssum χ δ x - (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
          ∫ y : ℝ, hInt χ δ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I))) :=

theorem explicit_formulaD {f : ℂ → ℂ} {B : ℝ → ℝ} {D CR : ℝ} (hd : LDatum f B D CR) {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k : ℕ, T k ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) + 1) ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => ∑ u ∈ zerosRectD f (T k), (multRectD f (T k) u : ℂ) * (mellin φ u * (x : ℂ) ^ u))
        atTop (𝓝 ((1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ((∫ y : ℝ, hIntD f φ x (((3 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)) -
          ∫ y : ℝ, hIntD f φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)))) :=

theorem explicit_formula_gen {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k : ℕ, T k ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) + 1) ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => ∑ u ∈ zerosRect χ (T k), (multRect χ (T k) u : ℂ) * (mellin φ u * (x : ℂ) ^ u))
        atTop (𝓝 (-SsumG χ φ x - (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
          ∫ y : ℝ, hIntG χ φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I))) :=

theorem explicit_formula_zeta {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k : ℕ, T k ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) + 1) ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => ∑ u ∈ zerosRectD zetaF (T k), (multRectD zetaF (T k) u : ℂ) *
          (mellin φ u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)) atTop
        (𝓝 (mellin φ 1 * x - SsumG (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) φ x -
          (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ y : ℝ, hZeta φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I))) :=
noncomputable def fP (δ t : ℝ) : ℂ := ((etaPlus t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (2 * π * I * δ * t)
noncomputable def flineD (δ t : ℝ) : ℂ := (1 / (2 * π) : ℝ) • 𝓕 (FhalfD δ) (t / (2 * π))

noncomputable def fδ (δ t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ((t ^ 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * cexp (2 * π * I * δ * t)

theorem gauss_tail {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) {W : ℝ} (hW : 3 / δ ≤ W) {C₁ κ₁ : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (hk : 0 ≤ κ₁) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f)
    (hle : ∀ u, 3 / δ ≤ u → f u ≤ Real.exp (-(δ ^ 2 * u ^ 2 / 2)) / u * (C₁ + κ₁ * Real.log (δ * u))) :
    ∫ u in (3 / δ)..W, f u ≤ (C₁ / 9 + κ₁ / 3) * Real.exp (-(9 / 2)) :=

  continuousAt :=

theorem goodSmoothing_fδ (δ : ℝ) : GoodSmoothing (fδ δ) (Kδ δ) 0.28 where
  continuousAt :=

theorem goodSmoothing_phi1 :
    GoodSmoothing phi1 ((Cg * (2 * aH)) ^ 2 * 8 * Real.exp 1) (1 / 400) where

theorem goodSmoothing_phi2 :
    GoodSmoothing phi2 (2 * ((Cg * (2 * aH)) ^ 2 * 8 * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (1 / 800))) (1 / 400) where

theorem good_height {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ T ∈ Icc (k : ℝ) (k + 1), ∀ σ ∈ [[(-1 / 2 : ℝ), 3 / 2]],
      (χ.LFunction ((σ : ℂ) + ((T : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) ≠ 0 ∧
        χ.LFunction ((σ : ℂ) + ((-T : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) ≠ 0) ∧
      (‖logDeriv χ.LFunction ((σ : ℂ) + ((T : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ Hk N k ∧
        ‖logDeriv χ.LFunction ((σ : ℂ) + ((-T : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ Hk N k) :=
theorem hH_eq_hHc {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : (hH 200 t : ℂ) = hHc t :=

    MellinConvergent phi2 s ∧ HasDerivAt (mellin phi1) (mellin phi2 s) s :=

theorem integral_etaSq : ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), etaSq v = 3 * √π / 8 :=

    ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.log v ^ 2 * etaPlus v ^ 2 ≤ 1.129 :=

theorem integral_log_sq_etaSq_le :

theorem integral_log_sq_phi1_sq_le :

theorem integral_log_sq_phi2_sq_le :

theorem integral_mom (k : ℕ) :
    ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), v ^ k * Real.exp (-v ^ 2) = (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma ((k + 1) / 2) :=

theorem integral_norm_sq_G_half (δ : ℝ) :

      2 * π * ∫ u in Ioi (0:ℝ), (u ^ 2 * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2)) ^ 2 :=

theorem integral_norm_sq_flineD (δ : ℝ) :
    ∫ t, ‖flineD δ t‖ ^ 2 = 2 * π * ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.log v ^ 2 * etaSq v :=

theorem integral_norm_sq_flineDG (hp : PlancherelData φ C c) :

theorem integral_norm_sq_flineDG_fP_le (δ : ℝ) :
    ∫ t, ‖flineDG (fP δ) t‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * π * 1.129 :=
theorem integral_norm_sq_flineD_le (δ : ℝ) : ∫ t, ‖flineD δ t‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * π * 0.1707 :=

    ∫ t, ‖flineG φ t‖ ^ 2 = 2 * π * ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖φ v‖ ^ 2 :=
theorem integral_norm_sq_fline_le (δ : ℝ) : ∫ t, ‖fline δ t‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * π * 0.6647 :=
theorem integral_phi1_sq_le : ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖phi1 v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 65.5 :=
theorem integral_phi2_sq_le : ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖phi2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 147.7 :=

theorem integral_rpow_exp_quad_le {p c b : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp2 : p ≤ 2) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ p * Real.exp (-(c / 2) * r ^ 2 + b * r) ≤
      Real.exp (b ^ 2 / (2 * c)) * ((1 + (b / c) ^ 2) * √(π / (c / 2)) + √π / (c * √(c / 2))) :=

theorem integral_rpow_exp_quad_le_ext {p c b : ℝ} (hp : -1 / 2 ≤ p) (hp2 : p ≤ 2) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ p * Real.exp (-(c / 2) * r ^ 2 + b * r) ≤
      Real.exp (b ^ 2 / c) * ((c / 4) ^ (-(1 / 4 : ℝ)) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma (1 / 4) +
        (c / 4) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma (3 / 2)) :=

    ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), v ^ q * Real.exp (-v ^ (2:ℝ)) = (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma ((q + 1) / 2) :=

theorem landau (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (hfc : f c ≠ 0) (hR : 0 < R) {B : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, ‖f z‖ ≤ B) (hBc : ‖f c‖ < B) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedBall c (R / 4))
    (hfz : f z ≠ 0) :
    ‖logDeriv f z - ∑ u ∈ zerosIn f c R (R / 2), ((divB f c R u).toNat : ℂ) / (z - u)‖ ≤
      48 * Real.log (B / ‖f c‖) / R :=

theorem logDeriv_L_near {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {T : ℝ} {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedBall (2 + T * I) (10 / 4))
    (hLz : χ.LFunction z ≠ 0) :
    ‖logDeriv χ.LFunction z - ∑ u ∈ zerosIn χ.LFunction (2 + T * I) 10 (10 / 2),
        ((divB χ.LFunction (2 + T * I) 10 u).toNat : ℂ) / (z - u)‖ ≤
      4.8 * Real.log (BT N T / 0.355) :=
theorem logDeriv_xiF_one_sub (w : ℂ) : logDeriv xiF (1 - w) = -logDeriv xiF w :=
theorem log_sq_le (v : ℝ) (hv : 0 < v) : Real.log v ^ 2 ≤ v + v⁻¹ - 2 :=

theorem mellin_fP_eq (δ : ℝ) {s : ℂ} (hs : -1 < s.re) :
    mellin (fP δ) s = ∫ ξ in Icc (-aH) aH, 𝓕 gC ξ * Gr (s - 1 + ((2 * π * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) δ 0 :=
theorem mellin_fδ (δ : ℝ) (s : ℂ) : mellin (fδ δ) s = Gr s δ 0 :=

theorem mellin_fδ_one (δ : ℝ) :
    mellin (fδ δ) 1 = 𝓕 (fun u : ℝ => ((if 0 < u then u ^ 2 * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2) else 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)) (-δ) :=
theorem mellin_g0 {s : ℂ} (hs : -2 < s.re) : mellin g0 s = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.Gamma ((s + 2) / 2) :=

theorem mellin_hHc_mul {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)))
    {C b : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hgb : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ‖g t‖ ≤ C * (t ^ b * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)))
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re + b) :
    mellin (fun t => hHc t * g t) s =
      ∫ ξ in Icc (-aH) aH, 𝓕 gC ξ * mellin g (s + ((2 * π * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) :=

theorem mellin_phi1_eq {s : ℂ} (hs : -2 < s.re) :
    mellin phi1 s = ∫ ξ in Icc (-aH) aH,
      𝓕 gC ξ * mellin (fun t => hHc t * g0 t) (s + ((2 * π * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) :=

theorem norm_G_le_regimeA (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) (hs0 : -1 ≤ s.re) (hs1 : s.re ≤ 1)
    (hy : 10 * π * |δ| ≤ |s.im|) (hm : |s.im| < 3 / 2 * (π * δ) ^ 2) :
    ‖Gr s δ 0‖ ≤ 0.588 * (|s.im| / (π * |δ|)) ^ 2 *
      Real.exp (-0.1065 * (|s.im| / (π * |δ|)) ^ 2) :=

theorem norm_G_le_regimeB (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) (hs0 : -1 ≤ s.re) (hs1 : s.re ≤ 1) (hτ : 50 ≤ |s.im|)
    (hδ : 3 / 2 * (π * δ) ^ 2 ≤ |s.im|) :
    ‖Gr s δ 0‖ ≤ 0.892 * |s.im| * Real.exp (-0.1598 * |s.im|) :=

theorem norm_G_tail (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) (hs0 : -1 ≤ s.re) (hs1 : s.re ≤ 1) {T0 : ℝ}
    (hT0 : max (10 * π * |δ|) 50 ≤ T0) (hτ : T0 ≤ |s.im|) :
    ‖Gr s δ 0‖ ≤ EB T0 * Real.exp (-0.1398 * (|s.im| - T0)) +
      EA T0 δ * Real.exp (-1.93 * ((|s.im| - T0) / (π * |δ|))) :=

theorem norm_G_tail_floor {δ T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : max (10 * π * |δ|) 50 ≤ T0) {s : ℂ} (hr1 : -1 ≤ s.re)
    (hr2 : s.re ≤ 1) (hτ : T0 < |s.im|) :
    ‖Gr s δ 0‖ ≤ EB T0 * rhoB ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ +
      EA T0 δ * rhoA δ ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ :=

theorem norm_G_uniform (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) (hs0 : -1 ≤ s.re) (hs1 : s.re ≤ 1) :
    ‖Gr s δ 0‖ ≤ 112 * Real.exp (-(thetaD δ * |s.im|)) :=

theorem norm_Gamma_le_rot {a : ℂ} (ha : 0 < a.re) {φ : ℝ} (hφ0 : 0 ≤ φ) (hφ : φ < π / 2) :
    ‖Complex.Gamma a‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(φ * |a.im|)) * Real.Gamma a.re * (Real.cos φ) ^ (-a.re) :=

theorem norm_Gr_le (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : |θ| < π / 4) (hs : -2 < s.re)
    (hsg : 0 ≤ θ * s.im) :

theorem circle_identity (X N : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ∫ α in (0:ℝ)..1, expSum X a α * expSum X b α * expSum X c α * e (-(N * α)) =
      ∑ n₁ ∈ range (X + 1), ∑ n₂ ∈ range (X + 1), ∑ n₃ ∈ range (X + 1),
        if n₁ + n₂ + n₃ = N then a n₁ * b n₂ * c n₃ else 0 :=

theorem circle_identity_tsum (N : ℕ) {a b c : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖)
    (hb : Summable fun n => ‖b n‖) (hc : Summable fun n => ‖c n‖) :
    IntegrableOn (fun α => expTsum a α * expTsum b α * expTsum c α * e (-(N * α)))
        (Set.Ioc 0 1) ∧
      ∫ α in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, expTsum a α * expTsum b α * expTsum c α * e (-(N * α)) =
        ∑ n₁ ∈ range (N + 1), ∑ n₂ ∈ range (N + 1), ∑ n₃ ∈ range (N + 1),
          if n₁ + n₂ + n₃ = N then a n₁ * b n₂ * c n₃ else 0 :=

noncomputable def expTsum (a : ℕ → ℂ) (α : ℝ) : ℂ := ∑' n, a n * e (n * α)

theorem large_sieve {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (α : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (β : ℝ)
    (hdisj : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint fun r => Set.Ioc (α r - δ / 2) (α r + δ / 2))
    (hsub : ∀ r ∈ s, Set.Ioc (α r - δ / 2) (α r + δ / 2) ⊆ Set.Ioc β (β + 1))
    (X : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ∑ r ∈ s, ‖expSum X a (α r)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (δ⁻¹ + 4 * Real.pi * X) * ∑ n ∈ range (X + 1), ‖a n‖ ^ 2 :=
